harnessCorrections.classification: Fixture defect; first results retained as invalid-fixture failures, not proof of an implementation defect.

harnessCorrections.scope: Fixture correction; no native binding change.

The later RNMapbox legacy listing refresh changes only pack enumeration; existing captures do not invoke it and keep their recorded outcomes. Storage reruns include the new peer JS. Final Android helper fix affects only storage file existence/readback; completed capture runs remain valid. MapLibre v4 database bytes are identical to the previously passed iOS v3 fixture.
